title: Freeze existing default CSS selector constructor behavior
api_or_output: Preserve frozen public CssSelector() constructor and define universal-selector default semantics without changing baseline

acceptance.description: Resolve existing constructor as immutable universal selector equivalent to Compile("*") with default namespaces, preserving all frozen APIs.
Compile constructor consumer and unchanged exact Selector baseline; constructor-specific missing-member negative control rejects.
Record owned source and checks without shipping runtime stubs or requiring later milestones.
